question.text: A parallel plate capacitor of area $60 \mathrm{~cm}^2$ and separation $3 \mathrm{~mm}$ is charged initially to $90 \mu \mathrm{C}$. If the medium between the plate gets slightly conducting and the plate loses the charge initially at the rate of $2.5 \times 10^{-8} \mathrm{C} / \mathrm{s}$, then what is the magnetic field between the plates ?

solution.text: Magnetic field between the plates in this case is zero.
